'''December 2001 Lancaster tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Warehouse, Lancaster, Pennsylvania on 29 December 2001. It is known from Rypcord Kline's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3222">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-30-lancaster-12-29-01d3222/ lancaster-12-29-01], DeckTech (Rypcord "Rypcord" Kline, 30 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-30-lancaster-12-29-01d3222/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 December 2001
* '''Site:''' The Warehouse, Lancaster, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
